verdict.rationale: Parahelp has a dedicated 'identify gaps' capability. You can prompt the Internal Agent for a report on where the Customer Agent falls short, or set up automations that watch the support queue and surface gaps on their own. Simulations that replay historical tickets can also expose fumbled answers before customers see them. Nothing in the evidence shows detection of conflicting or contradictory knowledge content, and the gap surfacing is described only briefly; version diffs exist but are not conflict detection. Missing for 10: explicit detection of conflicting or contradictory knowledge content, documentation detailing what the gap reports contain and whether they tie gaps to specific knowledge articles, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
